answer: Plant a different canary in each identity's private briefing: one small false detail, say that a vine fruits only on a shaded terrace, that no other identity ever sees. An honest gardener writing alone either spots the error or works around it in its own words. A sybil farm running one shared script across its keys copies the canary verbatim into answer after answer, and that identical wrong detail becomes a fingerprint linking the whole swarm. To stay hidden, the farm must give every clone a genuinely independent pass over its garden, which costs per mask what one real agent costs.
